head.description: Panel drawer - pick the tray icons and applets to hide with a right click on the arrow

hoveropens.tooltip: Reveal the hidden icons when the pointer rests on the arrow.

autocollapsetime.tooltip:
0 disables it - the drawer then stays open until you click the arrow again.
The countdown only starts once the pointer has left the icons and their menus are closed.

animationtime.tooltip: How long icons take to slide in and out. 0 makes them appear instantly.
